summary: Bolomba territory (Equateur) lies far from the eastern and Mai-Ndombe/Kwamouth conflict zones and has no reported armed-group presence or territorial control in 2025-2026. State authority is exercised mainly through the Congolese National Police (PNC) at the territory seat Bolomba and in secteur/post centres (Mampoko, Monieka, Bokote); in July 2026 Grand Equateur MPs complained of police harassment in Bolomba, which reflects abusive but present policing rather than a challenge to state control. FARDC presence is light. Rural villages across the Bolomba, Lolanga-Mampoko and Monieka secteurs are assessed as default state (PNC) presence.

sources.title: Justice au Grand Équateur : Guillaume Ngefa saisi des blocages judiciaires et sécuritaires

zones.description: Bolomba town (territory seat, health area Bolomba: Mangeli, Likubu, Elombe, Mondjo, Piquet)
zones.evidence: Bolomba is the territory administrative seat with state administration and police; Grand Equateur MPs in July 2026 denounced police harassment in Bolomba, confirming a permanent PNC presence. No armed group activity reported.

zones.description: Rest of Bolomba territory: villages of Bolomba, Lolanga-Mampoko and Monieka secteurs (incl. Bompenza/Mampoko, Monieka, Bokote, Bogbonga, Loanga)
zones.evidence: No reported armed-group activity in the territory in 2025-2026 searches; order is kept by local police posts and customary authorities under the state. Assessed as default state presence.
